Title: Azure API Management Analytics PowerBI solution template

Body.Content:
The Azure API Management Analytics PowerBI template allows you to create engaging, customizable dashboards that illustrate traffic flowing through your Azure API Management instance. Share those reports with business stakeholders, product managers, and senior leadership. Create your own store of API data that you can analyze, warehouse, or merge with other sources.

Read technical details about the PowerBI solution template.

Learn more
